business.scene_description: Households want to switch plugged-in appliances remotely, see the current power draw and be warned about overload.

properties.name: Active power
properties.interaction: Read-only number with a small trend chart

properties.name: Overload alarm
properties.interaction: Read-only; shown in red while the alarm is active

properties.name: Timer tasks
properties.interaction: List with add/edit/delete; wait for device report after each command

acceptance_criteria: A switch command changes the panel state only after the device reports the new state.
The overload alarm is shown in red within one report cycle after the device raises it.
Timer tasks created in the panel are listed again after an app restart.
Changing the report interval changes how often active_power is reported.
constraints.open_notes: Rated power is a placeholder in this synthetic example; take it from the hardware datasheet.
